subject: SV-model in INLA: problems with the student-t

messages.author: 10e365b589b230b7
messages.subject: SV-model in INLA: problems with the student-t
parts:
I'm trying to implement the SV-model example at R-INLA.org.

The gaussian R code works fine, but I have problems with the student-t distribution estimation.

When implementing the following R code:
model.t <- inla(ret~f(time,model="ar1",param=c(1,0.001,0,0.4),initial=c(2,3)),
           family="stochvol_t",data=poundd,control.compute=list(dic=T,mlik=T),
           control.predictor=list(return.marginals=T),control.inla=list(int.strategy="grid"))

I get the following error:
Error in inla.check.control(control.preditor):
Name 'return.maringals' in control-argument 'control.predictor', is void

I would appreciate any help
